evidence_backed_direction.retained_construct: Fresh Review verified the alias-safe source-tied then runtime-split lm_head construction, complete embedding preservation, deterministic independent candidate construction, and legal grouped Dynamic Scale32 execution at all 312 activation boundaries.
evidence_backed_direction.measured_failure: V3 through V6 retained one 16-entry codebook per complete Linear tensor. Their exact non-evaluator sequence matches were 3/8, 2/8, 1/8, and 2/8. V6 improved its block-covariance detector but worsened aggregate unweighted BF16 weight SSE to 3796.53346323738, showing that another loss-detector change within the same tensor-codebook representational class is not the highest-value next move.
evidence_backed_direction.replacement_hypothesis: Keep one 4-bit index per weight, one existing Scale32 record per output row, signed-Q4.4 codepoints, and the grouped Dynamic Scale32 A8 policy, but replace one codebook per tensor with one codebook per contiguous 128-input-lane block. The format is a strict representational superset of V4 because every block may reproduce the V4 tensor codebook, while independent block codebooks can model column-group distributions without adding per-group scales or widening the payload.
evidence_backed_direction.distinctness: V7 changes product geometry and codebook fetch sequencing. It is not a replay or detector-only reoptimization of V3 through V6: a standard decoder layer grows from seven tensor-codebook records to eighty input-block records while remaining below 4.036 stored bits per weight. The A8 policy, row-scale count, nibble payload width, public shell ports, and signed-8-bit codepoint multiply remain unchanged.

candidate_state_construction.initial_invariant: lm_head.weight and model.embed_tokens.weight are the same Parameter object and storage immediately after pinned-model load
candidate_state_construction.separation_rule: Before construction, replace only lm_head.weight with a detached byte-identical non-trainable clone and set only the in-memory candidate configuration tie_word_embeddings field to false.
candidate_state_construction.quantization_scope: exactly 168 transformer Linear weights plus the separated lm_head weight
candidate_state_construction.post_quantization_embedding_invariant: The original embedding Parameter object, storage pointer, shape, dtype, and complete BF16 byte stream remain unchanged.

weight_policy.packing: row-major output row then input lane; even flat index in low nibble and odd flat index in high nibble

row_scale.format: existing normalized unsigned-Q1.15 Scale32 significand plus signed exponent record
row_scale.all_zero_weight_row_rule: use the frozen all-zero Scale32 record and payload index of the nearest-to-zero codepoint in each input block

codebook.scope: one codebook per contiguous 128 input channels of each Linear tensor
codebook.block_count_rule: input_features divided by 128; every selected model Linear input dimension is exactly divisible by 128

input_block_joint_construction_algorithm.data_source: pinned BF16 weights and authenticated row Scale32 semantics only
input_block_joint_construction_algorithm.initial_state: Freshly reconstruct the complete V4 eight-iteration tensor-codebook result from pinned BF16 weights, copy its tensor codebook identically into every 128-lane input block, and copy its row Scale32 and payload state. This exactly reproduces the V4 decoded weights before any V7 update.
input_block_joint_construction_algorithm.objective: For each tensor, minimize exact unweighted BF16 source-space sum of squared reconstruction error over all output rows and input lanes.
input_block_joint_construction_algorithm.assignment_step: For each output row and 128-lane block, assign every BF16 weight to the nearest reconstructed level row_scale times block_codepoint_q4_4 divided by 16; exact-distance ties select the lower payload index.
input_block_joint_construction_algorithm.row_scale_step: With all block payload indices and block codebooks fixed, form the exact dyadic least-squares ideal across the complete output row and every input block. Constrain it to the no-overflow lower bound and legal Scale32 range; evaluate bracketing legal records, immediate normalized-significand neighbors, and the prior record. Choose minimum row SSE, then smaller positive scale, then smaller packed record.
input_block_joint_construction_algorithm.block_codebook_step: With payload and row scales fixed, optimize each 128-lane block independently. Accumulate exact per-cluster quadratic costs for every signed-Q4.4 value and use dynamic programming to select the globally minimum-cost strictly increasing 16-entry codebook. Empty clusters retain their prior value; cost ties choose the lexicographically smaller codebook.
input_block_joint_construction_algorithm.iteration_acceptance: Reassign after each row-scale and complete block-codebook sweep. The exact tensor SSE may not increase from the preceding outer iteration; a violation fails closed. Execute all eight iterations even after a fixed point.

activation_policy.payload: signed A8 symmetric range -127 through +127 with -128 reserved
activation_policy.base_record_source: the same frozen authenticated activation Scale32 significands used by V3 through V6
activation_policy.selection_rule: For each live finite group, preserve the base activation Scale32 significand and choose the minimum integer exponent delta in [-24,+24] whose effective exponent remains in [-24,+4] and covers every lane without saturation.
activation_policy.failure_rule: If no legal delta covers a finite group, fail closed; never clip, saturate, or mutate the base activation significand.

accelerator_facing_format.weight_payload_transport: existing 128-bit external-memory read channel; packed 4-bit indices retain the existing byte count
accelerator_facing_format.row_scale_transport: existing one 32-bit Scale32 record per output row; only record values may change
accelerator_facing_format.codebook_transport: one aligned 128-bit codebook beat before each contiguous 128-input-lane weight block; blocks are consumed in increasing input-channel order
accelerator_facing_format.cache_policy: two 16-byte banks hold current and next input-block codebooks; a block cannot issue until its codebook beat is authenticated and resident
accelerator_facing_format.compute_primitive: unchanged signed A8 activation multiplied by signed Q4.4 int8 codepoint, integer accumulation, row Scale32 application, and fixed fractional shift four

pre_attempt_closure.representation_gate: Fresh V4 reconstruction copied into every input block must reproduce the V4 decoded tensor exactly before optimization; after eight V7 iterations all 169 tensors must be non-regressing and aggregate unweighted BF16 SSE must strictly improve.
pre_attempt_closure.non_evaluator_quality_gate: The same frozen eight non-evaluator inputs must achieve 8/8 exact BF16 token arrays and 8/8 matching BF16 response-gate outcomes before an official marker may be created. Because V7 construction uses weights only, all eight inputs are construction-blind.
pre_attempt_closure.dynamic_gate: A fresh V7 candidate must cover all 312 named activation boundaries with legal deltas, zero saturation, zero clipping, no reserved -128 payload, and no more than 832 activation-metadata bytes per decoder-layer token.

block-count, ordering, codebook-cache sequencing, nibble-packing, Scale32, strict-codebook dynamic-programming, empty-cluster, tie-break, range, and hash-mismatch self-tests

PREATTEMPT_READY.json that verifies all artifacts without creating execution_started.json
pre_attempt_closure.failure_disposition: Preserve PREATTEMPT_NO_GO, leave the official attempt unconsumed, keep selected_policy_id null, and submit the bounded result for Fresh Review without accessing official inputs.

official_attempt.generation: deterministic greedy argmax; no sampling; use_cache=false; maximum six generated tokens; termination IDs 151643 and 151645
official_attempt.score_policy: binary only: 9/9 complete token arrays exactly equal BF16 and 9/9 response-gate outcomes equal BF16

risk_register: Input-block codebooks increase representational capacity but do not prove exact token identity; the eight-input exact gate remains mandatory and precedes official execution.
The row Scale32 record is shared across all input blocks of an output row, so block codebooks may still be insufficient even though the format strictly contains V4.

Codebook traffic rises by 1,168 bytes per standard decoder layer relative to V3 through V6; this is fully counted and remains below the 4.036 stored-bit cap, but measured latency and bandwidth effects require later cycle-accurate evidence.
The eventual RTL must authenticate and sequence codebook changes at 128-lane boundaries without changing public ports; no RTL work is authorized at specification stage.
Any accepted policy still requires Manager stage advance, focused RTL regression, fresh tree-specific PPA, local demo acceptance, and later U280 work.
